title: T1584 — Compromise Infrastructure
subtitle: Watch an attacker hijack a weak server and a domain, use them against a target employee, and see what the SOC notices at the same time.
aria: Animated diagram: an attacker compromises a server and a domain, phishes a target user, and a SOC detects and blocks the activity. A written step-by-step version follows below.
